instructions:
1. Anchor the rope and grip one end in each hand. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees softly bent, hips back.
2. Brace your core and hold your arms at your sides with a slight bend.
3. Drive one arm up to shoulder height while the other drives down, creating a wave.
4. Quickly alternate arms, keeping a fast steady rhythm without pausing.
5. Maintain a stable braced stance for the full work interval.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Generate the wave from the shoulders, not just the wrists.
2. Keep your core tight to limit excess torso sway.
3. Stay light on your feet with knees bent to absorb force.
4. Breathe steadily and keep the pace consistent.
name: Battle Rope Alternating Arm Waves

instructions:
1. Anchor the rope and grip one end in each hand. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees bent.
2. Raise both arms overhead while standing tall and extending the hips.
3. Slam both rope ends down hard toward the floor as you hinge slightly at the hips.
4. Let the rope rebound and immediately lift both arms back overhead.
5. Keep a fast, powerful rhythm for the full work interval.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the slam with your whole body, not just the arms.
2. Brace your core hard on each downward slam.
3. Hinge at the hips and bend the knees to load power.
4. Grip firmly to keep the rope ends under control.
name: Battle Rope Double Arm Slams

instructions:
1. Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
2. Tuck your toes and lift your knees about 5 cm off the floor, keeping your back flat.
3. Brace your core and step the right hand and left foot forward together.
4. Step the left hand and right foot forward, keeping the hips low and stable.
5. Continue crawling forward in this contralateral pattern for the work interval.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips level and avoid swaying side to side.
2. Maintain a flat back with your head in line with your spine.
3. Keep your knees hovering just off the floor throughout.
4. Move at a controlled pace to stay coordinated.
name: Bear crawls

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with arms at your sides. Place one foot on a raised surface about 30 cm high.
2. Cross the opposite ankle over the working knee to form a figure-four.
3. Brace your core and press through the working heel to lift your hips.
4. Raise until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to working knee.
5. Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower under control. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive through the heel of the working leg, not the toes.
2. Squeeze the glute hard at the top of each rep.
3. Keep your core braced to avoid arching the lower back.
4. Keep shoulders relaxed and flat on the floor.
name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with arms at your sides. Place both feet on a raised surface about 30 cm high.
2. Keep one foot flat and slide the other forward so only the heel rests on the edge.
3. Brace your core and press through the flat working heel to lift your hips.
4. Raise until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
5. Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower under control. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive through the heel of the working leg to bias that glute.
2. Squeeze the glute hard at the top of each rep.
3. Keep your hips level and core braced throughout.
4. Keep shoulders relaxed and flat on the floor.
name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
